description: Syntax highlighting, language server, compile preview and VM run for the .icg language compiled by ic10c
configuration.title: IC10 Go
icg.serverPath.desc: Path to the `ic10c` executable. Leave empty to use `ic10c` from PATH, or a binary named `ic10c` in the workspace folder.
icg.stableIns.desc: Compile with `--stable-ins` (the stable game branch's `ins` argument order). Leave off for the beta branch.
icg.autoTable.desc: Compile with `--auto-table`: table eligible constant switches into the data segment (run the install code first).
icg.jumpTable.desc: Compile with `--jump-table`: lower dense integer switches to a computed jump table.
icg.relJump.desc: Compile with `--rel-jump`: emit relative jumps (jr / br*) to save bytes (verify in game).
icg.fast.desc: Compile with `--fast`: prefer runtime speed over size (unroll more loops).
icg.unsafe.desc: Compile with `--unsafe`: skip the data-segment runtime check to shrink the code.
icg.dataAccess.desc: How the data-segment loader accesses the chip stack: `get` for a standard IC host, `stack` for device hosts (e.g. air conditioners).
icg.dynamicStack.desc: Size the user stack region from the compiler's data/spill usage instead of the fixed `icg.userStack` limit. Off by default.
icg.userStack.desc: Fixed user stack size (default 128). User slots at or above it are rejected at compile time.
icg.redundantDeviceWrites.desc: Drop constant device writes that repeat the previous value. Saves lines but changes the observable write sequence; off by default.
icg.runSteps.desc: Instruction budget for `IC10 Go: Run in VM` (`--steps`). 0 uses the compiler default (1000).
icg.runTrace.desc: Print every executed instruction when running in the VM (`--trace`).
icg.runSet.desc: Initial device values for `IC10 Go: Run in VM`, one per entry, e.g. `d0.Temperature=350` (repeatable `--set`).
cmd.compile: IC10 Go: Compile to IC10 (data loader included)
